**Test build 3** of Nexo v0.4 beta. Only friends on test builds get it; everyone else stays on v0.4.0-beta.1.

## What to test: game performance while Nexo is open

We found that Nexo itself could take a whole CPU core away from your game. Any animation on screen (the
pulsing dot on the **LIVE** badge while you stream, or on a friend's stream) made Nexo redraw its window about
60 times a second, even while a game covered it, and on NVIDIA every redraw kept one CPU core busy.

Now every animation pauses while Nexo isn't the focused window, which is always the case while you're in a
game. They resume when you switch back to Nexo.

## Please try

- Play the same game (CS2) with Nexo open, in voice, **streaming**, the way you did before. Does the game feel
  better than on test build 2 / beta 1?
- If you can: open **Task Manager → Details**, sort by CPU, and check the `Nexo.exe` processes while you play.
  None of them should sit at a high CPU % any more.
- Animations (LIVE badge, spinners) should still move when you look at Nexo.

## Install

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself (or **Settings → App → Check for updates**).

On v0.4.0-beta.1 and want to help test? Download `Nexo-Setup-0.4.0-test.3.exe` from the **Assets** below and
run it over your current Nexo. Your settings and login stay. SmartScreen may warn: **More info → Run anyway**.

To go back to the regular releases: **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
